        a = list(map(int, input[index:index + 2 * n]))
        index += 2 * n
        counter = Counter(a)
        possible = False
        x = None
        operations = []
        for candidate_x in set(a):
            temp_counter = counter.copy()
            temp_operations = []
            valid = True
            for _ in range(n):
                found_pair = False
                for i in range(len(a)):
                    for j in range(i + 1, len(a)):
                        if a[i] + a[j] == candidate_x and temp_counter[a[i]] > 0 and temp_counter[a[j]] > 0:
                            temp_counter[a[i]] -= 1
                            temp_counter[a[j]] -= 1
                            temp_operations.append((a[i], a[j]))
                            found_pair = True
                            break
                    if found_pair:
                        break
                if not found_pair:
                    valid = False
                    break
            if valid and all(v == 0 for v in temp_counter.values()):
                possible = True
                x = candidate_x
                operations = temp_operations
                break
        if possible:
            results.append("YES")
            results.append(str(x))
            for op in operations:
                results.append(f"{op[0]} {op[1]}")
        else:
            results.append("NO")
    print("\n".join(results))
